NOW.name: Current State Apr 2026
NOW.action_rationale: Wait for clarity on ceasefire outcome
NOW.description: Fragile ceasefire, Strait partially open, oil ~$99, gold ~$4,780

3M_ESCALATION.name: Escalation Jul 2026
3M_ESCALATION.action_rationale: Spike is short-lived historically; don't chase
3M_ESCALATION.description: Ceasefire collapses. New strikes on Iranian targets. Strait of Hormuz fully closed again. Oil spikes. USD surges on safe-haven flows. Gold spikes then fades.

3M_STALEMATE.name: Stalemate Jul 2026
3M_STALEMATE.action_rationale: Accumulate on dips during range-bound trading; invest €1,500
3M_STALEMATE.description: Ceasefire extended but no real progress. Partial Strait access. Oil elevated but stable. Markets adapt to new normal. Gold range-bound with high volatility.

3M_DEESCALATION.name: De-escalation Jul 2026
3M_DEESCALATION.action_rationale: Strong buy on dip — structural gold bull case intact; invest €2,000
3M_DEESCALATION.description: Meaningful diplomatic progress. Extended ceasefire with monitors. Strait fully reopened. Oil drops sharply. Risk premium fades. Gold falls in USD but EUR-gold more stable as USD weakens.

6M_WIDER_WAR.name: Wider War Oct 2026
6M_WIDER_WAR.action_rationale: Take profits on held position (sell €1,500 of €3k); extreme levels rarely sustained
6M_WIDER_WAR.description: Conflict spreads to Lebanon/Hezbollah front. Gulf state infrastructure hit. Global recession fears. Flight to safety overwhelms macro headwinds. Gold surges as systemic risk dominates.

6M_ESC_STALEMATE.name: Escalation→Stalemate Oct 2026
6M_ESC_STALEMATE.action_rationale: Buy dip after spike reversal; invest €1,500
6M_ESC_STALEMATE.description: Initial escalation burns out. Both sides exhausted. Partial Strait reopening. Oil eases from peak but stays elevated. Gold gives back spike gains. Real yields pressure persists.

6M_FORCED_PEACE.name: Escalation→Peace Oct 2026
6M_FORCED_PEACE.action_rationale: Strong buy — risk premium oversold; invest full €3k
6M_FORCED_PEACE.description: Escalation creates urgency for deal. Back-channel negotiations succeed. Comprehensive ceasefire with international monitors. Oil drops rapidly. Gold falls on risk premium collapse.

6M_SLOW_ESC.name: Slow Escalation Oct 2026
6M_SLOW_ESC.action_rationale: Hold existing position; wait for resolution clarity
6M_SLOW_ESC.description: Stalemate drifts toward escalation. Proxy attacks increase. Strait incidents become more frequent. Oil creeps up. Gold volatile, slight upward bias.

6M_CONT_STALEMATE.name: Continued Stalemate Oct 2026
6M_CONT_STALEMATE.description: More of the same. Markets fully price in 'new normal'. Oil stabilizes $95-105. Gold range-bound. Central bank buying supports, real yields cap upside.

6M_GRAD_DEESC.name: Gradual De-escalation Oct 2026
6M_GRAD_DEESC.action_rationale: Hold; gold structural bull intact despite conflict resolution
6M_GRAD_DEESC.description: Quiet diplomacy works. Confidence-building measures. Strait incidents decrease. Oil eases. Gold drifts lower but structural support holds.

6M_DEAL_FAILS.name: Deal Fails Oct 2026
6M_DEAL_FAILS.action_rationale: Already bought the dip; hold through volatility
6M_DEAL_FAILS.description: Initial progress reverses. Hardliners on both sides scuttle deal. Return to tensions. Oil rebounds. Gold recovers some of the de-escalation drop.

6M_PEACE_DEAL.name: Peace Deal Oct 2026
6M_PEACE_DEAL.action_rationale: Hold — structural gold supports (CB buying, debt levels) remain
6M_PEACE_DEAL.description: Comprehensive deal: sanctions relief, nuclear inspections, Strait guarantees. Oil normalizes. USD weakens. Gold falls in USD, stable in EUR. Risk premium fully unwound.

12M_PROLONGED_WAR.name: Prolonged War Apr 2027
12M_PROLONGED_WAR.action_rationale: Take full profits — extreme overshoot; sell entire position
12M_PROLONGED_WAR.description: Regional conflict entrenched. Global recession underway. Central banks cut rates → real yields plunge → gold soars. EUR gold at all-time highs.

12M_WAR_EXHAUSTION.name: War Exhaustion→Peace Apr 2027
12M_WAR_EXHAUSTION.action_rationale: Buy the peace — post-war overshooting creates opportunity
12M_WAR_EXHAUSTION.description: War exhaustion forces settlement. Rapid normalization. Oil crashes toward $75. Gold falls sharply but overshoots down. Good re-entry point.

12M_FROZEN_CONFLICT.name: Frozen Conflict Apr 2027
12M_FROZEN_CONFLICT.action_rationale: Hold — gold in structural bull market independent of Iran
12M_FROZEN_CONFLICT.description: Low-level frozen conflict like North Korea model. Markets fully adapted. Oil $90-100. Gold supported by structural factors, not conflict premium.

12M_ESC_RESOLUTION.name: Late Resolution Apr 2027
12M_ESC_RESOLUTION.action_rationale: Hold long-term; gold supported by non-conflict factors
12M_ESC_RESOLUTION.description: Prolonged process finally yields framework agreement. Oil normalizes. Gold gives back conflict premium but structural bull intact (CB buying, fiscal deficits).

12M_PEACE_HOLDS.name: Peace Consolidates Apr 2027
12M_PEACE_HOLDS.action_rationale: Hold — bought at bottom; long-term structural bull
12M_PEACE_HOLDS.description: Post-escalation peace deal holds. Sanctions partially lifted. Iran oil returns to market. Global growth recovers. Gold structurally supported but no conflict premium.

12M_LATE_ESCALATION.name: Late Escalation Apr 2027
12M_LATE_ESCALATION.action_rationale: Sell into spike — take profits on half position
12M_LATE_ESCALATION.description: Slow burn finally erupts. New military campaign. Markets shocked after complacency. Gold spikes hard.

12M_SLOW_RESOLUTION.name: Slow Resolution Apr 2027
12M_SLOW_RESOLUTION.action_rationale: Hold — conflict premium fading, structural bull remains
12M_SLOW_RESOLUTION.description: Tension gradually defused through back channels. Oil normalizes. Gold stable, supported by macro factors.

12M_NEW_NORMAL.name: New Normal Apr 2027
12M_NEW_NORMAL.action_rationale: Hold — range-bound but well-supported; collect on dips
12M_NEW_NORMAL.description: Permanent elevated baseline. Like post-2014 Russia sanctions. Oil $90-100 structural floor. Gold in $4,600-5,000 band. Volatility decreases as markets adapt.

12M_STALE_BREAKTHROUGH.name: Breakthrough Apr 2027
12M_STALE_BREAKTHROUGH.action_rationale: Hold — gold dip is temporary; structural supports strong
12M_STALE_BREAKTHROUGH.description: Unexpected diplomatic breakthrough after prolonged stalemate. Oil drops. Gold dips briefly then recovers as focus shifts to fiscal/monetary factors.

12M_NORMALIZED.name: Normalized Apr 2027
12M_NORMALIZED.action_rationale: Hold — structural gold bull transcends Iran conflict
12M_NORMALIZED.description: Full normalization of Gulf shipping. Iran nuclear deal 2.0. Oil back to $70-80. Gold stable, driven by macro not geopolitics. CB buying continues to support floor.

12M_RENEWED_TENSIONS.name: Renewed Tensions Apr 2027
12M_RENEWED_TENSIONS.action_rationale: Hold — already positioned from earlier buy
12M_RENEWED_TENSIONS.description: Failed deal leads to hardliner empowerment on both sides. New escalation cycle. Gold benefits from renewed uncertainty.

12M_POST_PEACE.name: Post-Peace Growth Apr 2027
12M_POST_PEACE.action_rationale: Hold — lowest price scenario but structural bull intact long-term
12M_POST_PEACE.description: Sustained peace. Global growth recovery. Gold moderates but stays supported by structural factors: CB buying, fiscal deficits, de-dollarization trend.
